body:
Your attached logs show two DRM-protected playbacks with the demo app that seemed to have worked fine based on the EventLogger output. 

If you want us to investigate further, it would be helpful if you could provide a test stream and/or logs that show the problem. In case you don't want to post the stream publicly, you can send an email to exoplayer.dev@gmail.com with "Issue #8372" in the subject and then report back here that you've send the stream url.

Hi @tonihei I ve shared the test content via exoplayer.dev@gmail.com, please use that content to reproduce the issue,the content is generated using widevine test credentials.

We are testing the content in Realme and Nvidia shield devices.
The root cause for getting stuck looks the same as in #6896. In this case it's audio track though and it's not the final segment, so may as well be unrelated.
Hi Team, We observed that playback is happening with 720p CMAF content, but unable to play with 1080p.

I suspect the issue is caused by the lack of discontinuity alignment. The discontinuity in the video variant happens at t=16s and in audio at t=6s. The audio loading cannot continue because it waits for timestamp adjustment initialization by the video variant, but the video variant does not load because the CompositeSequenceableLoader sees the video's next load position is further ahead in time.

I will continue investigation next week and see what the best next steps are.

Hi,

@AquilesCanta any update on this,we are struck at this issue.

Hi, we won't be able to look into this until mid-February unfortunately. A few actionable items you can take on to push this forward:
- We would like to know a bit more how the content was generated. That is, could you provide us with instructions on how to generate similar content using shaka packager?
- I would also suggest generating equivalent content with a MacOS-supported DRM scheme, so as to evaluate playback with quick time, to ensure it's doing what you expect it to do, and not something like audio and video out of sync.

The problem we currently have is that the content discontinuities are not aligned. I haven't found anything in the spec forbidding it, but at the same time I struggle to imagine a real world scenario where it makes sense to have non-aligned discontinuities.

Hi @AquilesCanta ,

We are using the following command to generate the content  using shaka packager

> packager 'in=llama_3_original.mp4,stream=video,init_segment=init_v.mp4,segment_template=v_$Number$.m4s' 'in=/home/gaian/llama_3_original.mp4,stream=audio,init_segment=init_a.mp4,segment_template=a_$Number$.m4s' --enable_widevine_encryption --key_server_url https://license.uat.widevine.com/cenc/getcontentkey/widevine_test  --content_id 7465737420636f6e74656e74206964 --signer widevine_test --aes_signing_key 1ae8ccd0e7985cc0b6203a55855a1034afc252980e970ca90e5202689f947ab9  --aes_signing_iv d58ce954203b7c9a9a9d467f59839249 --hls_master_playlist_output h264_master.m3u8

Hi @SharanKumarReddyKambham, would you kindly provide us with a copy of llama_3_original.mp4? That way we can look into why the content is being generated with a strange structure. We are not yet convinced this is worth fixing in the ExoPlayer codebase. You can either post it here, or send it to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com. Discussed with @christosts and we agreed we would try to decide whether this content is valid, or perhaps a bug in shaka-packager, in which case we might want to contact the shaka team.
